limitations: One timed screen per variant; no statistical confidence interval.
Outputs may change when admission or floating-point reductions change.
No candidate is promoted solely on a kernel microbenchmark.
Fresh twenty held-out contracts remain unscored during tuning.
RAM speed was not measured. Earlier bandwidth/activity evidence remains separate.

fp8_microbenchmarks.protocol: One CUDA graph timing per tuple: 1,000 warmup launches and 1,000 timed launches. Smaller matrices include both a single-copy mode and a rotating operand set of about 128 MiB; the vocabulary matrix has one copy. GPU event time excludes host scheduling. These are kernel measurements, not model qualification.

source.change: Benchmark reader honors sealed RAM FDs; arithmetic unchanged.

fp8_microbenchmarks.limitation: Individual FP8 gains did not predict the global accumulator experiment, which lost model throughput.

prefill_microbenchmarks.protocol: Synthetic expert dimensions, six balanced rotated samples per variant. Each sample uses 64 CUDA graph launches with three rotating compressed operand copies. Tile zero reconstructs the complete FP16 matrix and calls cuBLAS; the other variants reconstruct tiles inside WMMA kernels. GPU event time excludes host scheduling.

safety.scope: Complete synthetic prefill test execution; not a whole-model bank memory check.

results.scope: Boundary tiles, short K slices, normal/outlier activations and missing-scratch rejection
Expert matrix dimensions at16/128/512 token rows, each with normal and outlier activations
Boundary tiles, short K slices, normal/outlier activations and missing-scratch rejection

prefill_microbenchmarks.finding: Every new 128-row split-K variant was slower than reconstruction plus cuBLAS. The existing 32-row kernel improved down projections at16/32/64 rows; this is a kernel result only. The new split-K kernel is not called by the model executor.

failed_experiments.name: drop55-v14
failed_experiments.scope: Rejected timing; separate matched two-warmup library-prefault retries required.

activation.scope: Instrumented safety check with real promotions; timings excluded.

original_bank_v12.finding: Four increasingly focused diagnostics were intentionally interrupted because of instrumentation cost and the rejected throughput tradeoff. No clean v12 bank memory-check claim.

slab_v20.scope: One complete 4096-input prefill and clean shutdown, including active slab banks on both GPUs. One output ID, no decode timing or quality claim. All model kernels instrumented; repeated requests covered by separate uninstrumented screens.

bank_qualification.status: Rejected:7/8 long-context reused training contracts, versus8/8 control.
bank_qualification.protocol: Two full warmups, one discarded single-decode-advance request, three timed8192-input/512-output requests, clean exit, identical repeats, zero timed major faults, swap and EOS IDs. Long training uses eight previously public contracts with deterministic frozen neutral prefixes of4096–4102 tokens; no fresh held-out scoring.
bank_qualification.finding: Repeated prefill gain3.13%; small decode difference1.51% is not claimed with unlocked clocks. Candidate failed the argmin_first answer-format contract. Original short49% decode ratio was confounded by CPU scale-cache preparation. Selected KDA preset unchanged.

results.label: control-v14
results.scope: Eight reused public training contracts; no held-out scoring.

results.label: drop60-v14-r2
results.scope: Eight reused public training contracts; no held-out scoring.

budget_quality.decision: Route budget0.60 rejected:5/8 training contracts versus8/8 for the matched0.50 control. Full512 throughput qualification skipped; no selected loss bounds changed.

direct_output_prefill_probe.scope: Isolated synthetic CUDA probe; production executor and selected presets unchanged.
direct_output_prefill_probe.protocol: Eight balanced rotated samples per variant at sixteen expert shapes, repeated with default and100% shared-memory carveout. Each event timing uses64 graph launches with three rotating compressed operands. Negative tiles denote direct global WMMA stores, with a bounded shared tail for incomplete16-row fragments. Tile-256 uses1/2/4 K partitions.
direct_output_prefill_probe.sanitizer_scope: Small boundary suite: N32/96, K64/128/192/256/320, M9 through257 including partial fragments, ordinary and outlier activations. Large benchmark shapes checked numerically, without sanitizer instrumentation.
direct_output_prefill_probe.finding: Every new256-row variant lost to reconstruction plus cuBLAS at every tested shape and carveout. Small32-row down-projection wins reproduce the earlier result; the selective model trial supplied no throughput gain. No new kernel selected.

fixed_half_decode_probe.scope: Synthetic FP8 data at four model projection shapes; not checkpoint-derived inputs or model timings.
fixed_half_decode_probe.protocol: Six balanced rotated graph-event samples per tuple,64 graph launches per timing. A matched number of operand copies gives about128MiB of half operands and64MiB of FP8 codes for smaller shapes; vocabulary has one copy. Split is requested where recorded; columns2048 retains the unsplit dispatcher path.
fixed_half_decode_probe.verification_widths: 1–8, ordinary and outlier activations, native block FP8 and packed MXFP8; small memcheck/race fixtures include extreme MX scales.
fixed_half_decode_probe.finding: The half lane cache reduced query-projection kernel time37–48% and vocabulary time25% in these synthetic fixtures. Extra fixed GPU storage and possible expert-capacity changes require model measurements; no selected preset changed.

fixed_half_production_kernel_checks.scope: Full synthetic native-format test suite, including exact cached operands, packed/native MXFP8 and block FP8, independent scalar reconstruction checks, bitwise skinny widths1–8 with and without supported K splitting. Model screens remain separate.

fixed_half_model_decision.status: Rejected all tested variants; no fixed-half preset selected.
fixed_half_model_decision.protocol: One full warmup, discarded one-decode-advance request, one timed8192-input/128-output request. Every reported completed screen had zero timed major faults, swap and EOS IDs. Short screens do not establish512-output throughput.
fixed_half_model_decision.finding: Neither uncapped fixed FP16 storage nor bounded subsets improved model decode3% while retaining98% prefill. Synthetic kernel gains did not yield a faster selected model configuration.
